plugin.name: Splinter Cell Double Agent Widescreen Fix
GRAPHICS.ShadowMapResolutionMultiplier.d: Multiplier for shadow map resolution. Higher values increase shadow quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.GlowResolutionMultiplier.descri: Multiplier for glow effect resolution. Higher values increase glow quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.MirrorResolutionMultiplier.desc: Multiplier for reflection resolution. Higher values increase reflection quality but may reduce performance. Multiplier range: (0-16). Restart required.
MAIN.ResX.description: Startup width in pixels. If either resolution value is 0, use the desktop resolution. The in-game resolution selector also updates these values. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Startup height in pixels. If either resolution value is 0, use the desktop resolution. The in-game resolution selector also updates these values. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
MAIN.HudWidescreenMode.description: Offsets certain HUD elements to the screen edges. Restart required.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Keep the HUD inside a centred box of the chosen aspect ratio. Auto uses the full screen width. Requires widescreen HUD scaling. Applies immediately.
MAIN.ForceLL.description: Fixes the startup crash. This is equivalent to the -ll shortcut switch. Restart required.
MISC.FPSLimit.description: Recommended: 60, increasing the frame rate can lead to issues with AI pathfinding and physics objects. Restart required.
BONUS.BlacklistIndicators.description: Make the goggles and suit lights respond to visibility: 0 keeps the original lights, 1 brightens them in darkness, and 2 brightens them in light. Restart required.
BONUS.GogglesLightColor.description: Change the goggles and suit light color. 0 keeps the original color, 2 uses red and 3 orange; other enabled values use green. Restart required.
BONUS.LightSyncRGB.description: Only Logitech hardware is supported. Requires the Logitech G HUB app. Restart required.
MISC.EnableRunDuringForcedWalk.descripti: Allows running during forced walk sections. Restart required.
MAIN.DisablePreCache.description: Experimental: improve loading times by disabling pre cache (may cause issues with certain sounds not loading). Restart required.
MISC.SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and intro videos. Story videos still play. Restart required.
MAIN.SingleCoreAffinity.description: Experimental: attempts to avoid mid-loading hangs (may cause performance issues). Restart required.
ONLINE.ForceWindowedMode.description: Run the multiplayer game in a window. This does not change single-player window settings. Restart the multiplayer game.
ONLINE.FPSLimit.description: Multiplayer frame rate limit. 0 disables this limiter. Restart the multiplayer game.
ONLINE.FullScreenRefreshRateInHz: Full Screen Refresh Rate In Hz
ONLINE.FullScreenRefreshRateInHz.descrip: Fullscreen refresh rate for multiplayer, in Hz. 0 keeps the game choice; an out-of-range value uses the highest available rate. Restart the multiplayer game.
FORCEWINDOWED.UsePrimaryMonitor.descript: Use the primary monitor for the multiplayer window. Restart the multiplayer game.
FORCEWINDOWED.CenterWindow.description: Center the multiplayer window on its monitor. Restart the multiplayer game.
FORCEWINDOWED.AlwaysOnTop.description: Keep the multiplayer window above other windows. Restart the multiplayer game.
FORCEWINDOWED.ForceWindowStyle.descripti: Multiplayer window style: 0 keeps its style, 1 fills the monitor without borders, and 2 adds a title bar. Requires forced windowed mode. Restart multiplayer.
ONLINE.FPSLimitMode.description: Multiplayer limiter timing: 1 uses a busy wait, 2 sleeps between checks to reduce CPU use. Restart the multiplayer game.
GRAPHICS.BlurEnabled.description: Enable the game blur effect. Turn it off for a sharper image. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.BlurStrength.description: Strength of the blur effect when Blur is enabled. Lower values reduce blur. Restart required.

menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; presets preserve your choice.
ui.nativegraphicsoverrides.description: Apply the shipped native graphics overrides on startup. Disable to preserve native graphics settings; resolution and input remain managed separately. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.AnisotropicFiltering.descriptio: Keeps textures sharp at steep viewing angles. Off keeps the game's own filtering. Restart required.
